description: Points a domain (or, with the host parameter, a subdomain) at a SaaS product's website hosting: up to four A and two AAAA records at the root, a www CNAME, a wildcard (*) CNAME, the _acme-challenge CNAME the host uses to issue the site's certificate, and DoDomain's ownership TXT at _dodomain-challenge. Every record is its own group, applied via groupId; record hosts are fixed. Used by DoDomain (domain-connect-as-a-service) on behalf of its integrator applications; sharedProviderName is set so the consent screen can name the integrator beside DoDomain.
variableDescription: ipv4a..ipv4d = the IPv4 addresses of the root A records (groups a-a..a-d); ipv6a, ipv6b = the IPv6 addresses of the root AAAA records (groups aaaa-a, aaaa-b); wwwTarget = the CNAME destination of www (group www); wildcardTarget = the CNAME destination of * (group wildcard); acmeTarget = the CNAME destination of _acme-challenge (group acme-challenge); token = DoDomain's ownership token after the fixed 'dodomain-verify=' prefix (group verify). Variables: ipv4a, ipv4b, ipv4c, ipv4d, ipv6a, ipv6b, wwwTarget, wildcardTarget, acmeTarget, token.
